title: Measurement
description: One measurement record produced by the probe. Shared contract for probe, backend and dashboard. One row per (workload, endpoint) run.

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the measurement, ISO 8601.

run_id.description: Groups the three endpoint runs of one scheduled heavy workload.

endpoint.description: Which endpoint family this run hit.

target.description: Concrete host or label the run measured.

ok.description: True if the run completed and produced valid metrics.

error.description: Error detail when ok is false.

metrics.description: Numeric results. Expected keys per workload (all optional so the schema stays stable): web -> dns_ms, connect_ms, ttfb_ms, load_ms; video -> startup_ms, rebuffer_count, rebuffer_ms; email -> fetch_ms; download -> throughput_mbps, bytes; baseline -> dns_ms, rtt_ms, jitter_ms, loss_pct; path -> hops.

context.description: Environment captured with every record so changes show up in the data.

raw_ref.description: Blob Storage key for a large raw payload (e.g. full traceroute JSON). Null when there is none.

net_hash.description: Truncated + hashed public IP (ethics: site is not identifiable from stored data).
